- **#8841** (also written #PD-8841), gate kiosk timeout:

- **INC-4821**, Hartford status-page access issue: #inc-vtg-hartford, Aug 3 2026.
- **VT-55120**, root-cause ticket for the Hartford kiosk outage: #inc-vtg-hartford, Oct 14 2026. I haven't opened the ticket.

A few digest entries describe Vantorre issues without a ticket number, so I left them off the list. I also only read those three sources, so this isn't the full ticket history. Anything that exists only in the support system won't be here.
